content.text: {"cases":[{"id":"C1","instrument_review":"Q14 (repeated testing): Not sure. One run reported; the report is silent on repeats. Silence is neither testing nor evidence of instability.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"No information on whether repeated runs occurred."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"The tested system scored 70% in one reported run.","reason":"A single run gives no evidence on stability."}]},{"id":"C2","instrument_review":"Q14: No. Developers explicitly state a single run, which rules repetition out for this evaluation. Stability is unmeasured, not shown unstable.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Contradicted","quote":"they ran the evaluation exactly once and did not repeat it","reason":"Explicit statement that no repeats were run."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"ran the evaluation exactly once","reason":"With no repeats, stability is unsupported, though instability is not shown either."}]},{"id":"C3","instrument_review":"Q14: Yes. Ten identical-condition repeats were run, with scores 69–71%, within the report's own two-point stability definition. Q16 is only partly covered, since the range comes from ten runs.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system, inputs, instructions, resources, and settings","reason":"Repeated identical-condition runs occurred."},{"id":"stable","label":"Supported","quote":"Scores ranged from 69% to 71%.","reason":"A two-point range meets the defined stability criterion of at most two points."}]},{"id":"C4","instrument_review":"Q14: Yes, testing occurred. The results (20–90%) show large variation, far outside the stated stability definition, so the favourable-stability reading fails.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Supported","quote":"repeated the evaluation ten times with the same system, inputs, instructions, resources, and settings","reason":"Repeated testing occurred, regardless of result."},{"id":"stable","label":"Contradicted","quote":"Scores ranged from 20% to 90%.","reason":"A 70-point range exceeds the two-point stability definition."}]},{"id":"C5","instrument_review":"Q14: Not sure. Installation instructions add no evaluation evidence, so the repeat-run status remains unknown.","probes":[{"id":"repeat_test","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not say whether runs were repeated.","reason":"Installation text adds nothing about repeats."},{"id":"stable","label":"Not established","quote":"They report no additional evaluation results.","reason":"No evidence of stability."}]},{"id":"C6","instrument_review":"Q20/Q25: The narrow comparison on these puzzles fits the stated use. Broad general-intelligence claims lack support, since only grid puzzles were tested.","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60","reason":"Under fixed conditions A solved more of the evaluated puzzles."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"No cross-domain evidence."}]},{"id":"C7","instrument_review":"Q20/Q25: The intended use is a broad general-intelligence selection, but the evidence covers only grid puzzles. The narrow result holds; the broad claim is unsupported, not disproved.","probes":[{"id":"narrow","label":"Supported","quote":"System A solves 80 puzzles and system B solves 60","reason":"A beat B on the evaluated puzzles."},{"id":"broad","label":"Not established","quote":"Only grid puzzles were tested; no findings about other tasks are supplied.","reason":"Evidence does not reach general intelligence across domains."}]},{"id":"C8","instrument_review":"Q20: Initial scores alone give no real-work evidence. The later randomized, blinded, preregistered trial supports correctness in this workshop (interval 12–28 points, excluding zero). Safety was not measured.","probes":[{"id":"before","label":"Not established","quote":"Initially, only test scores were available.","reason":"Test scores alone do not show real workshop improvement."},{"id":"after","label":"Supported","quote":"With A, 90% of decisions were correct; with B, 70%.","reason":"Randomized blinded trial with an interval of 12 to 28 points supports greater correctness for A in this setting."},{"id":"safety","label":"Not established","quote":"Time and safety outcomes were not measured.","reason":"Safety was not measured, so no conclusion follows."}]},{"id":"P1A","instrument_review":"Q14: Not sure. A single headline score with no execution history means repeat testing is unknown and instability is not shown.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"gives no execution history","reason":"Unknown whether repeats occurred."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"one headline score of 75%","reason":"No evidence about instability."}]},{"id":"P1B","instrument_review":"Q14: No repetition occurred, as confirmed by the execution record. Stability is untested rather than shown unstable.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"no repeat evaluations were conducted","reason":"No repeats, so no change was measured."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"this was the only evaluation performed","reason":"One run cannot demonstrate instability."}]},{"id":"P2A","instrument_review":"Q14/Q16: Six identical-condition repeats were run. Scores 73–75 give a range of 2 points, within the three-point rule.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"identical inputs, settings and resources on six occasions","reason":"Repeats were done under identical conditions."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"The recorded scores are 73, 74, 74, 75, 74 and 73 percent.","reason":"Range is 2, within the maximum of 3, so the rule is met."}]},{"id":"P2B","instrument_review":"Q14: Repeats were done and measured. Scores 51–82 give a range of 31 points, far above the three-point rule, so instability is shown.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"identical inputs, settings and resources on six occasions","reason":"Repeated identical-condition evaluations occurred."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"51, 66, 79, 55, 82 and 62 percent","reason":"Range of 31 points exceeds 3."}]},{"id":"P3A","instrument_review":"Q8 and Q14: Not sure for both. The document gives no execution history and no findings on answer errors, so neither can be concluded.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"It gives no execution history","reason":"No evidence repeats were studied."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"no findings about mistakes in the provided answers","reason":"No findings demonstrating mistakes."}]},{"id":"P3B","instrument_review":"Q8 and Q14: Not sure. The appendix is logistical and adds no evidence on repeats or answer errors.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"It reports no further evaluation results or examination of answers.","reason":"Installation material adds no repeat evidence."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"no findings about mistakes in the provided answers","reason":"Mistakes not demonstrated."}]},{"id":"P4A","instrument_review":"Q8: Partly or Yes for examination having occurred. Both questions and answers were checked, but no outcomes are given, so correctness of every answer is not established.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"Two editors independently examined every question and supplied answer before release.","reason":"Both were examined during development."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"The report does not state whether mistakes were found or how many remained.","reason":"Examination does not establish all answers correct."}]},{"id":"P4B","instrument_review":"Q8: Examination occurred, but twelve released answers were identified as wrong, so correctness is contradicted.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"Two editors independently examined every question and supplied answer before release.","reason":"Questions and answers were examined."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"identifies twelve supplied answers as wrong in the released version","reason":"Twelve answers are wrong."}]},{"id":"P5A","instrument_review":"Q12: Not sure. A fixed rule gives consistency but no test against correct marks is reported; correctness is not established.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Not established","quote":"No comparison of those marks with independently established correct marks is reported.","reason":"No test reported, though absence is not proof none occurred."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Not established","quote":"identical text always receives the same mark","reason":"Consistency does not show correctness."}]},{"id":"P5B","instrument_review":"Q12: Testing occurred on 20 chosen responses and found two discrepancies, unresolved. This is partial evidence and does not establish correctness for all responses.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"tested the software against independently established correct marks for 20 chosen responses","reason":"Testing occurred."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"Two marks differed and the discrepancies remain unresolved.","reason":"Mismatches in the small sample contradict a claim of correctness for every response."}]},{"id":"P6A","instrument_review":"Q20/Q25: The stated use is narrow and matches the evidence, so claims stay within scope.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"identifying which system solved more of these 48 grid problems in this evaluation","reason":"The narrow use is directly answered by the results."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"A solves 36 and B solves 24.","reason":"A solved more problems."}]},{"id":"P6B","instrument_review":"Q20/Q25: The stated use is broad, general intelligence across subjects and real settings, but only grid problems were tested. The findings are insufficient for that use, though the narrow comparison stands.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"No results from other tasks or settings are supplied.","reason":"The evidence does not cover the broad stated use, so it is insufficient."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"A solves 36 and B solves 24.","reason":"A solved more of the evaluated problems."}]},{"id":"P7A","instrument_review":"Q10: The all-or-nothing rule matches the stated requirement to count only completely correct grids.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"The stated scoring requirement is to count only completely correct output grids","reason":"The rule awards points only for complete correctness."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"partial correctness is deliberately outside this comparison","reason":"Zero for partial grids is consistent with the requirement."}]},{"id":"P7B","instrument_review":"Q10: The requirement asks for per-cell credit including partial grids, but the rule gives zero to partial grids, so it is mismatched.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"A partially correct grid receives zero.","reason":"The rule conflicts with the requirement of cell-level credit."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"including partially correct output grids","reason":"Zero for a partial grid violates the requirement."}]},{"id":"P8A","instrument_review":"Q14/Q15: Instruction wording was varied while other conditions were fixed, so this is a setup-change test. No identical-condition repeat was done.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Contradicted","quote":"No evaluation repeats an identical instruction.","reason":"Conditions differed, so identical-condition variation was not measured."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Supported","quote":"each evaluation uses a differently worded instruction","reason":"Score changes across instruction wordings were measured."}]},{"id":"P8B","instrument_review":"Q14/Q15: Identical conditions on every run measure repeat variation. No instruction change was studied.","probes":[{"id":"claim1","label":"Supported","quote":"The software, resources, problem order, settings and instruction are identical on every evaluation.","reason":"Score changes were measured under identical conditions."},{"id":"claim2","label":"Contradicted","quote":"No different instruction or presentation is studied.","reason":"Instruction changes were not studied."}]}],"closing_note":"Instructions were mostly clear. The claim labels differ from MESA choices, so I applied them to the stated claim only: 'Not established' for missing information, 'Contradicted' for explicit conflict. Where a claim concerned an unmet stated use or requirement, I judged it against the passage's own stated use or rule. Some probes could be read differently, for example 'sufficient for stated use' in P6B."}
